record.question: Jimmy ____________ his homework before the teacher comes.
record.explanation: Answer D: all of these. All three statements are grammatical for different meanings (desire, obligation, necessity), so “all of these” (D). Independent check: “Wants to do,” “has to do,” and “needs to do” are all grammatical with the future time clause; option D says all are possible. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-the-to-infinitive. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
